name: 2 Peter
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: The apostle Peter. Some scholars question this, while the church has long affirmed it.
setting: Written to warn against false teachers.
theme: Grow in knowledge of Christ and hold fast until he returns.

outline.label: Make your calling and election sure
The reliability of the apostolic testimony
Scoffers and the patience of the Lord

christInBook: Peter speaks of the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ (1:16), the transfiguration as an eyewitness testimony, and the promise of new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells (3:13).
howToRead: 2 Peter is Peter’s farewell. Notice his concern that readers remember what they have been taught and not be carried away by false teachers.
